how to turn 1 simple comment into sales while you sleep.

No Photoshop needed. Just this 3-minute formula with copy-paste prompts 🧵👇

1/ Why 90% of AI visuals look messy:

• Starting with a blank prompt
• Too many elements (clutter)
• Zero grid structure

Rule: Lock your layout with a reference image first.

2/ Step 1: Pick a Visual Blueprint (Green Amoeba Starburst Museum Poster)

Never start from scratch. Upload a reference and let Nano Banana copy the container grid and typography.

3/ Step 2: The Exact Prompt Formula

"Use reference style for layout. Swap headline to: [YOUR HEADLINE]. Razor-sharp vector typography, 4:5 vertical."

4/ Step 3: Layer Micro-Accents

• Stepped polygon color blocks
• Rotated vertical margin tags
• Top timestamp header ("05 NOV // 8:37 PM")

5/ 💾 The Saveable Cheat Sheet:

• Ratio: 1080x1350 (4:5)
• Background: #F5F5F0 off-white gallery paper
• Style: Green Amoeba Starburst Museum Poster
• Zero plastic sheen

6/ The 3-Minute Routine:

1. Save reference image
2. Feed into Nano Banana with structured prompt
3. Deliver free asset pack via automated DM keyword

7/ Golden Rules:

✦ Stop the scroll on Slide 1
✦ Explain with diagrams on Slides 2-7
✦ Give away free prompts on every post
